newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Chlor Alkali says it fulfils '96 target.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Chlor Alkali says it fulfils '96 target.

text.p: Shanghai Chlor Alkali Chemical Co Ltd said it had fulfilled its 1996 target of more than 230 million yuan post-tax profits, about the same level as 1995's 231.5 million yuan based on international accounting standards, a company spokesman said.
Turnover was a little lower than last year's 2.37 billion yuan, the spokesman said, but declined to give exact figures.

Prices of the company's key product, PVC, fell in 1996 to an average of about 7,000 yuan per tonne from 8,000 yuan in 1995 but the company managed to offset the losses by improving its management and cutting expenditure, he said.
